MEA Official Describes PM Modi's Direct Engagement Style

An official from India's Ministry of External Affairs described Prime Minister Modi's political approach as favoring direct contact with the electorate, bypassing intermediaries. This method is seen as a key factor in his electoral success and sustained tenure as Prime Minister. The official's remarks were made during a visit to New Zealand.
